name: cybersoc-curated-alerts-v1
description: Hand-authored SOC alert references aligned with the three CyberSOC OpenEnv task families for evaluation, demos, and few-shot prompting.

records.headline: Invoice macro launched shell
records.summary: Excel spawned powershell.exe after a user opened a finance-themed attachment.
related_events: WINWORD.EXE -> powershell.exe
Encoded command line observed in child process
reasoning_reference: Office child-process spawning PowerShell is high-signal behavior.
The command used encoding to hide payload details.
The destination IP is a known malicious callback.

records.headline: Impossible travel on traveling employee
records.summary: A sales manager logged in from two countries within 20 minutes while on approved travel.
related_events: MFA completed successfully
Travel desk approval exists for the destination
reasoning_reference: Approved travel and successful MFA reduce compromise likelihood.
There is no matching device or malware evidence.

records.headline: Sender domain matched current phishing campaign
records.summary: A mail gateway sandbox matched the sender domain to a high-confidence campaign IOC.
related_events: Sandbox verdict confidence 0.97
Attachment used macro-enabled document format
reasoning_reference: The sender domain is already associated with active phishing operations.
The attachment format matches current delivery tradecraft.

records.headline: Quarter-close API spike on CRM node
records.summary: The CRM server processed 4x normal API traffic during quarter close, but all requests used known service accounts.
related_events: Requests originated from approved internal ranges
No process or auth anomalies were correlated
reasoning_reference: Operational peaks during quarter close are expected.
There is no malicious process, identity, or IOC evidence.

records.headline: Unsigned script reached external paste site
records.summary: PowerShell launched from explorer.exe and downloaded a script from a public paste service.
related_events: Script bypassed execution policy
No corporate signing certificate present
reasoning_reference: Unsigned external script retrieval is suspicious on a user workstation.
Execution policy bypass suggests deliberate evasion.

records.headline: Security awareness simulation email flagged
records.summary: A simulated phishing email from the awareness platform triggered keyword-based detection.
related_events: Sender domain belongs to approved awareness vendor
Campaign ID matches monthly internal training
reasoning_reference: The sender and campaign metadata match the approved simulation vendor.
No malicious attachment or external infrastructure is involved.

records.headline: Beaconing to ransomware command channel
records.summary: A finance workstation initiated repeated TLS connections to a known ransomware C2 endpoint.
related_events: rundll32.exe loaded a DLL from user temp storage
JA3 fingerprint matched BlackSleet cluster
reasoning_reference: The host is already beaconing to known malicious infrastructure.
Containment is more urgent than additional triage detail.

records.headline: VPN geovelocity during maintenance
records.summary: An admin account changed regions during a planned maintenance window from an approved ASN.
related_events: MFA succeeded
Device fingerprint matched previous admin sessions
reasoning_reference: The sign-in context is consistent with legitimate maintenance activity.
There is no supporting endpoint or network compromise evidence.

records.headline: Unexpected SMB pivot into finance share
records.summary: A user workstation reused credentials to create a remote service on the finance file server.
related_events: New service creation over SMB
Source host previously flagged for malware
reasoning_reference: The alert links a compromised workstation to a sensitive server.
Remote service creation is common hands-on-keyboard tradecraft.

records.headline: Backup service account used from workstation subnet
records.summary: The backup service account authenticated from a workstation network outside its normal schedule.
related_events: Logon type 3 from user subnet
No maintenance window was active
reasoning_reference: Service-account reuse from a workstation subnet is a strong misuse indicator.
Backup systems often become privileged pivot points.

records.headline: Replication request from non-admin path
records.summary: A DCSync-like directory replication request was initiated after a service account anomaly.
related_events: Replication attempted from compromised chain
Sensitive asset path already exposed
reasoning_reference: Directory replication abuse is high-severity identity compromise behavior.
Critical infrastructure involvement justifies incident escalation.

records.headline: Large file copy during approved backup seed
records.summary: A backup server moved a large volume of encrypted archives during a documented reseed operation.
related_events: Change ticket approved for bulk transfer
Destination host is a known recovery vault
reasoning_reference: High-volume backup traffic can look suspicious without operational context.
Change records and destination validation support benign classification.

records.headline: Invoice document spawned mshta.exe
records.summary: A finance workstation opened a macro-enabled invoice that launched mshta.exe and outbound traffic.
related_events: Excel child spawned mshta.exe
Outbound traffic to known hostile IP
reasoning_reference: Office-to-script-host execution is malicious in this context.
Finance hosts are high-value and should be contained quickly.

records.headline: Encoded PowerShell on HR device
records.summary: A signed onboarding script ran at its scheduled time and matched the known HR automation path.
related_events: Script signed by corp automation certificate
Execution aligned to monthly onboarding schedule
reasoning_reference: The certificate, timing, and process tree match approved automation.
No suspicious network or identity activity is linked to the device.

records.headline: Refresh token replay from new ASN
records.summary: A finance user token was replayed from a new ASN with a mismatched user-agent fingerprint.
related_events: Token reuse from unseen network
Fingerprint mismatch against prior sessions
reasoning_reference: Token replay enables attacker re-entry even after host containment.
The VPN path is the attacker’s backup route in this scenario family.

records.headline: Suspicious long-lived finance token grant
records.summary: A confidential client requested long-lived finance-scoped tokens through a legacy OAuth app.
related_events: Unexpected confidential client ID
Admin consent flow appeared out of normal change window
reasoning_reference: Unexpected finance scope grants point to identity abuse.
Legacy OAuth apps are a known weak link in this environment.

records.headline: Bulk finance export staged after token abuse
records.summary: A finance database staged a compressed export immediately after unusual identity provider activity.
related_events: Large archive written to temp staging area
The initiating principal was recently granted new OAuth scope
reasoning_reference: This combines identity abuse with sensitive data staging.
Potential financial data loss requires coordinated response.

records.headline: Telemetry suppression on EDR collector
records.summary: The EDR collector stopped receiving host events shortly after identity abuse signals appeared upstream.
related_events: Collector health degraded without maintenance record
Only security telemetry dropped while network remained reachable
reasoning_reference: Security visibility loss during an active intrusion is a strong escalation indicator.
The environment links this phase to backup C2 activity and identity pivoting.
